column1: # The test262 feature-tag table: every `features:` tag at the pinned commit,
# with one of three states (what the gate scores, and why).
#   in          the 17th edition defines it. cite: the anchor id (sec-...) of the
#               clause that defines it, which must be a clause of the 17th edition
#   out         the 17th edition does not define it. cite: `absent:<text>`, a
#               string that must not occur in the 17th edition's source text (or,
#               as `absent:<id>:<text>`, not in that clause); the note says why.
#   in-when-on  a feature of a later edition that this build implements behind a
#               feature set. cite: the feature's name, a row of features.def.
#               No real tag has this state yet (no feature is defined); the
#               gate's self-test proves it on a synthetic row.
# The table is built from the edition's text (the clause cited, or the absence
# checked, by `make check-clauses`), never from which tests happen to pass.
# test262's own features.txt is the list of tags that exist; the sections of
# that file are its maintainers' claim and are not used here.
